name: Rep-Bucket Point-in-Time Fix (INF_B_00 historical-attribution drift)
description: INF_B_00.canonical_holdings.py joins positions_mv@snap_date_str against accounts_v2@LATEST (latest_accounts_v2_key returns keys[-1] regardless of snap_date_str). Result: every historical holdings_{date}.parquet row carries CURRENT advisor-attribution via rep_bucket, not point-in-time attribution as it existed on snap_date. Downstream impact: leaderboard period_start_aua MAX window all-null + lifecycle_aua per-advisor decomposition all-zero. HISTBF.004 *enabled* the fix (per-date accounts_v2 silver now exists 2020-05-26 forward) but did not perform it. Surfaced empirically in DS~B holdings_2026-04-01.parquet inspection 2026-05-04 + DS~D §3 verdict (`docs/architecture/_drafts/INFLEC_AUDIT_DSD_HISTBF_STATE.md`). Scope: switch latest_accounts_v2_key() → accounts_v2_key_for_date(snap_date_str) and pin representatives lookup analogously if rep-name evolution matters. Spawned from ADVI_INFLEC.AUDIT-001 cell ruling — period_start_aua + lifecycle_aua RED cells route here, not HISTBF.
